tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture a bounded ui_control snapshot from the scoped application window. Start here before UI actions; use the returned snapshot_id when acting so stale controls can be detected. On Windows, DccServerBase automatically supplies its trusted adapter PID/HWND/title context. Dedicated servers can bind the DCC through DCC_MCP_UI_CONTROL_PROCESS_ID or DCC_MCP_UI_CONTROL_WINDOW_HANDLE. A request title can narrow a trusted PID to one window, and all request scope can only narrow the binding. A locked, disconnected, or secure Windows desktop returns desktop_unavailable without ending the logical session. After unlock, discard old ids and take a fresh snapshot to restore the capsule. Coordinates belong only to this adapter host and DCC logon session; RDP/session or monitor topology, resolution, and DPI changes require a fresh snapshot. A bounded target may span monitors whose virtual-desktop origins are negative or whose DPI differs; action coordinates remain PNG-relative.

window_handle.description: Native handle of the scoped application window.

window_title.description: Title substring for the scoped application window.

process_name.description: Process name used to resolve the scoped application window.

resume_computer_use.description: Explicitly resume native DCC UI Control after the user stopped a session with Esc. Agents must leave this false unless the user asks to resume control.

tools.description: Start CUA trajectory recording for the exact application session. The output directory must be absolute and is passed to the standalone CUA Host. Continue with scoped UI actions, then call recording_stop. Set record_video when the installed CUA driver should capture video evidence.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Perform one scoped semantic or DCC UI Control action. Supports control ids, snapshot coordinates, pointer paths, text, and key presses where the selected backend supports them. Request policy may narrow or deny raw input. Every Windows mutation requires an adapter/operator-bound PID/HWND so the visible capsule and user interruption monitor cover semantic UIA as well as raw input. Raw input is enabled by default inside that exact bound scope and can be disabled with DCC_MCP_CUA_ALLOW_RAW_INPUT=false. Windows hard-denies raw type: enter non-sensitive text only through semantic set_text with an exact control_id. Passwords, authentication codes, and other credential material require a user hand-off or a host-owned secure credential flow. The type action is backend-specific to mock/CDP and is not a portable Windows action. Windows keypress rejects ordinary printable, Shift-text, and AltGr-text input; use only navigation/control/function keys or genuine Ctrl/Alt shortcuts. Windows game_navigation is the separately governed game-canvas path: it accepts up to four simultaneous supported canvas keys or `+` chords and an optional 0..500 ms hold, while preserving the existing raw-text denial. For application menu bars, invoke_menu resolves an explicit native menu_path inside the exact bound window. Prefer it when semantic menu clicks or Alt mnemonics cannot prove that a Qt popup opened; it never guesses pixels and always requires a fresh snapshot for verification. For a custom-drawn DCC canvas or face control that has no semantic node, use a path from the latest snapshot for one drag; Ctrl, Shift, and Alt in keys are held as pointer modifiers. Snapshot again immediately afterward. get_window_state, restore_window, show_window, and activate_window are recovery operations for the same host-bound PID/HWND and do not require a prior snapshot. They cannot enumerate or target another process/window; restore/show/activate invalidate any prior snapshot and are audited. desktop_unavailable means no Windows UI input was sent; keep the logical session, stop issuing UI calls, and ask the user to unlock or reconnect. Take a fresh snapshot only after that happens. Never use coordinates from the gateway, another host, or another logon session.

action.description: Action kind to perform. type is backend-specific to mock/CDP and is hard denied by the Windows backend; use semantic set_text with an exact control_id for non-sensitive Windows text entry. Windows keypress cannot synthesize ordinary printable text. game_navigation accepts up to four simultaneous supported keys for a non-editable DCC or game canvas; it is not a text-entry action. invoke_menu uses menu_path and does not require a prior snapshot.

skills.name: verification
skills.description: Cross-DCC verification toolset - deterministic capture review views, in-band image statistics, scene-vs-spec validation, and reference-vs-render comparison sheets. Pure Python, read-only, DCC-agnostic. Use to close the quality loop without shipping pixels to a model: flag white/near-black/gamma-broken frames from stats alone and catch missing-UV/missing-part exports before export. Not for scoring or aesthetic review - this toolset packages evidence and computes no scores.
